data.name: Carbons Finland
data.description: Carbons Finland Oy is a micro-enterprise in Kouvola, Finland, founded in 2014, producing willow-based porous biochar for stormwater treatment, landscaping, composting, nutrient recycling and organic farming. Products are sold under the Carbons brand and the company is listed on the Puro.earth biochar registry. Revenue was approximately €324k in 2023 with roughly one employee.
